{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Check if patients with biomarker_baseline == -999 are in the treatment arm
# and whether they have a responded value

# Identify patients with biomarker_baseline == -999
mask_invalid_baseline = df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999
invalid_baseline_patients = df[mask_invalid_baseline]['patient_id'].unique()

# Check if any of these patients are in the treatment arm
invalid_treatment_patients = df[mask_invalid_baseline & (df['arm'] == 'treatment')]

# Count how many such patients exist and whether they have a responded value
n_invalid_treatment = len(invalid_treatment_patients)

# Check if responded is available (i.e., not NaN) for these patients
responded_available = invalid_treatment_patients['responded'].notna().all()

# Print results
print(f'Number of patients with biomarker_baseline == -999: {len(invalid_baseline_patients)}')
print(f'Number of those in treatment arm: {n_invalid_treatment}')
print(f'Are responded values available for them? {responded_available}')"}
